newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-HILL JOINS FOOTWORK FORMULA ONE TEAM.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-HILL JOINS FOOTWORK FORMULA ONE TEAM.

text.p: World championship leader Damon Hill said on Friday he will drive for the Footwork Formula One team next year.
The Briton, unwanted by Williams for 1997, will join his new team on a one year contract after the season-ending Japanese Grand Prix at Suzuka on October 13.
Hill, who needs just one more point to clinch the drivers' title, was refused a fresh contract by team boss Frank Williams at the end of August.No reason was given.
Footwork cars driven by Dutchman Jos Verstappen and Brazilian Ricardo Rosset have scored only one championship point in 15 races this year.
The team is based in Britain and owned by Tom Walkinshaw.
